meta.title: Witnessing The End
meta.description: Extinction is our destiny, the final and fairest of all outcomes.

units.rawText: Jiutian sector, at the space elevator.
units.displayText: Jiutian sector, at the space elevator.

spans.text: Jiutian sector, at the space elevator.

units.rawText: Fresnel, how's the changeover going?
units.displayText: Fresnel, how's the changeover going?

spans.text: Fresnel, how's the changeover going?

units.rawText: The battle is still raging around the space elevator, with Xinghuan holding position beside it with all her firepower, her guns constantly firing.
units.displayText: The battle is still raging around the space elevator, with Xinghuan holding position beside it with all her firepower, her guns constantly firing.

spans.text: The battle is still raging around the space elevator, with Xinghuan holding position beside it with all her firepower, her guns constantly firing.

units.rawText: Hss—
units.displayText: Hss—

spans.text: Hss—

units.rawText: Although the comet has been destroyed, the entropics on its fragments are still present in shocking numbers.
units.displayText: Although the comet has been destroyed, the entropics on its fragments are still present in shocking numbers.

spans.text: Although the comet has been destroyed, the entropics on its fragments are still present in shocking numbers.

units.rawText: Anna's already deciphered the data. All we need to do now is receive it. Our progress is currently at 50%...
units.displayText: Anna's already deciphered the data. All we need to do now is receive it. Our progress is currently at 50%...

spans.text: Anna's already deciphered the data. All we need to do now is receive it. Our progress is currently at 50%...

units.rawText: Get away from the space elevator!
units.displayText: Get away from the space elevator!

spans.text: Get away from the space elevator!

units.rawText: The space elevator's barrier is beginning to crack... At this rate...
units.displayText: The space elevator's barrier is beginning to crack... At this rate...

spans.text: The space elevator's barrier is beginning to crack... At this rate...

units.rawText: (We can't go on like this. I don't know what Yuwang did to hold the battle lines together...)
units.displayText: We can't go on like this. I don't know what Yuwang did to hold the battle lines together...

spans.text: We can't go on like this. I don't know what Yuwang did to hold the battle lines together...

units.rawText: (But I'm sure he won't be able to delay them for long...)
units.displayText: But I'm sure he won't be able to delay them for long...

spans.text: But I'm sure he won't be able to delay them for long...

units.rawText: Clickclickclickclick—
units.displayText: Clickclickclickclick—

spans.text: Clickclickclickclick—

units.rawText: Liuxing! I need more bullets!
units.displayText: Liuxing! I need more bullets!

spans.text: Liuxing! I need more bullets!

units.rawText: Beepbeep—
units.displayText: Beepbeep—

spans.text: Beepbeep—

units.rawText: Down to the last magazine, huh...
units.displayText: Down to the last magazine, huh...

spans.text: Down to the last magazine, huh...

units.rawText: Warnings about her ammo levels, operand levels and the exo's structural integrity fill her command console.
units.displayText: Warnings about her ammo levels, operand levels and the exo's structural integrity fill her command console.

spans.text: Warnings about her ammo levels, operand levels and the exo's structural integrity fill her command console.

units.rawText: Xinghuan looks at a distant piece of debris. It's the last remaining fragment of the comet.
units.displayText: Xinghuan looks at a distant piece of debris. It's the last remaining fragment of the comet.

spans.text: Xinghuan looks at a distant piece of debris. It's the last remaining fragment of the comet.

units.rawText: Beep—
units.displayText: Beep—

spans.text: Beep—

units.rawText: A faint alert suddenly sounds. Xinghuan turns to look toward faraway Jupiter, as though she's received some kind of premonition.
units.displayText: A faint alert suddenly sounds. Xinghuan turns to look toward faraway Jupiter, as though she's received some kind of premonition.

spans.text: A faint alert suddenly sounds. Xinghuan turns to look toward faraway Jupiter, as though she's received some kind of premonition.

units.rawText: Jiutian flagship signal lost.
units.displayText: Jiutian flagship signal lost.

spans.text: Jiutian flagship signal lost.

units.rawText: What...
units.displayText: What...

spans.text: What...

units.rawText: Xinghuan looks at her display. The signal representing the Ringworld slowly dims, then vanishes.
units.displayText: Xinghuan looks at her display. The signal representing the Ringworld slowly dims, then vanishes.

spans.text: Xinghuan looks at her display. The signal representing the Ringworld slowly dims, then vanishes.

units.rawText: ...Yuwang...
units.displayText: ...Yuwang...

spans.text: ...Yuwang...

units.rawText: ...You kept saying I was too impulsive, but the truth is, you weren't any better yourself...
units.displayText: ...You kept saying I was too impulsive, but the truth is, you weren't any better yourself...

spans.text: ...You kept saying I was too impulsive, but the truth is, you weren't any better yourself...

units.rawText: Xinghuan, Yuwang's...
units.displayText: Xinghuan, Yuwang's...

spans.text: Xinghuan, Yuwang's...

units.rawText: Never mind that, hurry up and finish the changeover!
units.displayText: Never mind that, hurry up and finish the changeover!

spans.text: Never mind that, hurry up and finish the changeover!

units.rawText: Hubble...
units.displayText: Hubble...

spans.text: Hubble...

units.rawText: <size=40>Xinghuan? What are you doing?</size>
units.displayText: Xinghuan? What are you doing?

spans.text: Xinghuan? What are you doing?

units.rawText: Before Xinghuan can speak, Hubble can already sense that something is wrong with her.
units.displayText: Before Xinghuan can speak, Hubble can already sense that something is wrong with her.

spans.text: Before Xinghuan can speak, Hubble can already sense that something is wrong with her.

units.rawText: Looks like I won't be able to finish the mission in person. Sorry about that...
units.displayText: Looks like I won't be able to finish the mission in person. Sorry about that...

spans.text: Looks like I won't be able to finish the mission in person. Sorry about that...

units.rawText: Make sure you help me save Jiutian sector! I know you guys can do it!
units.displayText: Make sure you help me save Jiutian sector! I know you guys can do it!

spans.text: Make sure you help me save Jiutian sector! I know you guys can do it!

units.rawText: As Hubble looks at the forced smile on Xinghuan's face, her heart turns bitter.
units.displayText: As Hubble looks at the forced smile on Xinghuan's face, her heart turns bitter.

spans.text: As Hubble looks at the forced smile on Xinghuan's face, her heart turns bitter.

units.rawText: Yes, we will...
units.displayText: Yes, we will...

spans.text: Yes, we will...

units.rawText: Liuxing... Go with Hubble and Fresnel.
units.displayText: Liuxing... Go with Hubble and Fresnel.

spans.text: Liuxing... Go with Hubble and Fresnel.

units.rawText: Deetdeet—
units.displayText: Deetdeet—

spans.text: Deetdeet—

units.rawText: Really? I see... Thank you, Liuxing.
units.displayText: Really? I see... Thank you, Liuxing.

spans.text: Really? I see... Thank you, Liuxing.

units.rawText: Xinghuan closes her hands around the exo's controls and slowly rises.
units.displayText: Xinghuan closes her hands around the exo's controls and slowly rises.

spans.text: Xinghuan closes her hands around the exo's controls and slowly rises.

units.rawText: She has one magazine left, there are numerous enemies, and the fragments of the comet hang menacingly in space.
units.displayText: She has one magazine left, there are numerous enemies, and the fragments of the comet hang menacingly in space.

spans.text: She has one magazine left, there are numerous enemies, and the fragments of the comet hang menacingly in space.

units.rawText: Xinghuan pushes her control stick forward and once again she soars through space like a shooting star, darting between the purple entropic comets.
units.displayText: Xinghuan pushes her control stick forward and once again she soars through space like a shooting star, darting between the purple entropic comets.

spans.text: Xinghuan pushes her control stick forward and once again she soars through space like a shooting star, darting between the purple entropic comets.

units.rawText: Dark purple silhouettes race past her, but Xinghuan has locked onto her target and she pulls the trigger.
units.displayText: Dark purple silhouettes race past her, but Xinghuan has locked onto her target and she pulls the trigger.

spans.text: Dark purple silhouettes race past her, but Xinghuan has locked onto her target and she pulls the trigger.

units.rawText: <size=40>HELLBORE CANNON! FIRE!!!</size>
units.displayText: HELLBORE CANNON! FIRE!!!

spans.text: HELLBORE CANNON! FIRE!!!

units.rawText: An intense beam of light pierces the comet chasing the spaceship, blowing it to smithereens. The remains transform into entropic creatures and turn on Xinghuan instead.
units.displayText: An intense beam of light pierces the comet chasing the spaceship, blowing it to smithereens. The remains transform into entropic creatures and turn on Xinghuan instead.

spans.text: An intense beam of light pierces the comet chasing the spaceship, blowing it to smithereens. The remains transform into entropic creatures and turn on Xinghuan instead.

units.rawText: <size=40>Point defense guns, lock onto the Entropics and fire!!!</size>
units.displayText: Point defense guns, lock onto the Entropics and fire!!!

spans.text: Point defense guns, lock onto the Entropics and fire!!!

units.rawText: Yaaaaaaaah—
units.displayText: Yaaaaaaaah—

spans.text: Yaaaaaaaah—

units.rawText: The entropics are quickly mowed down by Xinghuan's barrage of fire.
units.displayText: The entropics are quickly mowed down by Xinghuan's barrage of fire.

spans.text: The entropics are quickly mowed down by Xinghuan's barrage of fire.

units.rawText: Clickclickclick—
units.displayText: Clickclickclick—

spans.text: Clickclickclick—

units.rawText: As her last magazine runs dry, Xinghuan continues swinging her sword as she thrusts into the face of the entropic attack until she arrives in front of the cometary fragment.
units.displayText: As her last magazine runs dry, Xinghuan continues swinging her sword as she thrusts into the face of the entropic attack until she arrives in front of the cometary fragment.

spans.text: As her last magazine runs dry, Xinghuan continues swinging her sword as she thrusts into the face of the entropic attack until she arrives in front of the cometary fragment.

units.rawText: Since I'm out of ammo... There's only one thing I can do!
units.displayText: Since I'm out of ammo... There's only one thing I can do!

spans.text: Since I'm out of ammo... There's only one thing I can do!

units.rawText: Thruster output to maximum! Remove all limiters! Ignore all overload warnings!
units.displayText: Thruster output to maximum! Remove all limiters! Ignore all overload warnings!

spans.text: Thruster output to maximum! Remove all limiters! Ignore all overload warnings!

units.rawText: She viciously slams her control stick forward and her exo shoots toward the comet like a silver arrow.
units.displayText: She viciously slams her control stick forward and her exo shoots toward the comet like a silver arrow.

spans.text: She viciously slams her control stick forward and her exo shoots toward the comet like a silver arrow.

units.rawText: The exo spreads its arms and directly takes the force of the comet's impact on its frame.
units.displayText: The exo spreads its arms and directly takes the force of the comet's impact on its frame.

spans.text: The exo spreads its arms and directly takes the force of the comet's impact on its frame.

units.rawText: You're nothing but a big chunk of rock, aren't you? I'll just throw you back!
units.displayText: You're nothing but a big chunk of rock, aren't you? I'll just throw you back!

spans.text: You're nothing but a big chunk of rock, aren't you? I'll just throw you back!

units.rawText: The title of Jiutian sector's ace taikonaut isn't for show!
units.displayText: The title of Jiutian sector's ace taikonaut isn't for show!

spans.text: The title of Jiutian sector's ace taikonaut isn't for show!

units.rawText: With the comet chunk firmly in her grip, Xinghuan muscles it in the direction of Mars and boosts toward it at top speed.
units.displayText: With the comet chunk firmly in her grip, Xinghuan muscles it in the direction of Mars and boosts toward it at top speed.

spans.text: With the comet chunk firmly in her grip, Xinghuan muscles it in the direction of Mars and boosts toward it at top speed.

units.rawText: The parts touching the comet are infected by the Entropy and turn purple. With that, her arms completely cease to function.
units.displayText: The parts touching the comet are infected by the Entropy and turn purple. With that, her arms completely cease to function.

spans.text: The parts touching the comet are infected by the Entropy and turn purple. With that, her arms completely cease to function.

units.rawText: Hss—
units.displayText: Hss—

spans.text: Hss—

units.rawText: The nearby entropics seem to realize what Xinghuan has in mind and hurry over to stop her.
units.displayText: The nearby entropics seem to realize what Xinghuan has in mind and hurry over to stop her.

spans.text: The nearby entropics seem to realize what Xinghuan has in mind and hurry over to stop her.

units.rawText: However, a little figure stands in their way.
units.displayText: However, a little figure stands in their way.

spans.text: However, a little figure stands in their way.

units.rawText: Beepbeep—
units.displayText: Beepbeep—

spans.text: Beepbeep—

units.rawText: <size=40>Kaboom—</size>
units.displayText: Kaboom—

spans.text: Kaboom—

units.rawText: As his parts scatter through the cosmos, little Liuxing has only managed to buy Xinghuan a moment.
units.displayText: As his parts scatter through the cosmos, little Liuxing has only managed to buy Xinghuan a moment.

spans.text: As his parts scatter through the cosmos, little Liuxing has only managed to buy Xinghuan a moment.

units.rawText: Liuxing...
units.displayText: Liuxing...

spans.text: Liuxing...

units.rawText: <size=40>Divert all operands to thruster systems!</size>
units.displayText: Divert all operands to thruster systems!

spans.text: Divert all operands to thruster systems!

units.rawText: <color=red><size=100>YAAAAAAAAAAAA—</size></color>
units.displayText: YAAAAAAAAAAAA—

spans.text: YAAAAAAAAAAAA—

units.rawText: Xinghuan pushes her control stick forward as far as it will go. It breaks with a loud "crack!"
units.displayText: Xinghuan pushes her control stick forward as far as it will go. It breaks with a loud "crack!"

spans.text: Xinghuan pushes her control stick forward as far as it will go. It breaks with a loud "crack!"

units.rawText: However, the incoming fragment finally changes direction, heading out into the endless depths of space where Xinghuan's exo is pushing it.
units.displayText: However, the incoming fragment finally changes direction, heading out into the endless depths of space where Xinghuan's exo is pushing it.

spans.text: However, the incoming fragment finally changes direction, heading out into the endless depths of space where Xinghuan's exo is pushing it.

units.rawText: System command... 2887...
units.displayText: System command... 2887...

spans.text: System command... 2887...

units.rawText: I'll leave Jiutian sector to you... Hubble...
units.displayText: I'll leave Jiutian sector to you... Hubble...

spans.text: I'll leave Jiutian sector to you... Hubble...

units.rawText: Xinghuan reflexively reaches out toward the void. In her daze, she can almost see a familiar face.
units.displayText: Xinghuan reflexively reaches out toward the void. In her daze, she can almost see a familiar face.

spans.text: Xinghuan reflexively reaches out toward the void. In her daze, she can almost see a familiar face.

units.rawText: Yuwang...
units.displayText: Yuwang...

spans.text: Yuwang...

units.rawText: Looks like in the end, we both gave the same answer...
units.displayText: Looks like in the end, we both gave the same answer...

spans.text: Looks like in the end, we both gave the same answer...

units.rawText: We both fought to the very end. It must have been hard, Xinghuan.
units.displayText: We both fought to the very end. It must have been hard, Xinghuan.

spans.text: We both fought to the very end. It must have been hard, Xinghuan.

units.rawText: It's so cold. Was space always this cold?
units.displayText: It's so cold. Was space always this cold?

spans.text: It's so cold. Was space always this cold?

units.rawText: Still, the embers of hope will endure. Right, partner?
units.displayText: Still, the embers of hope will endure. Right, partner?

spans.text: Still, the embers of hope will endure. Right, partner?

units.rawText: As long as the stars shine upon us... we shall be reunited in Jiutian...
units.displayText: As long as the stars shine upon us... we shall be reunited in Jiutian...

spans.text: As long as the stars shine upon us... we shall be reunited in Jiutian...

units.rawText: Yeah...
units.displayText: Yeah...

spans.text: Yeah...

units.rawText: <color=orange>I believe... We'll meet again in Jiutian someday...</color>
units.displayText: I believe... We'll meet again in Jiutian someday...

spans.text: I believe... We'll meet again in Jiutian someday...

units.rawText: <size=40>Boom—</size>
units.displayText: Boom—

spans.text: Boom—

units.rawText: A brilliant flare of operands blossoms in the void.
units.displayText: A brilliant flare of operands blossoms in the void.

spans.text: A brilliant flare of operands blossoms in the void.

units.rawText: As its remains slowly fall, the white star finally burns itself out beside the space elevator...
units.displayText: As its remains slowly fall, the white star finally burns itself out beside the space elevator...

spans.text: As its remains slowly fall, the white star finally burns itself out beside the space elevator...
